context: A police officer briefs on coordination
purpose: Teach: 商談/延び/挑ん/ショートカット/変われ/つなげる/折り紙/乗り継ぎ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の商談的な会合、近年、増えています。
lines.en: Police-community partnership meetings have been increasing in recent years.
lines.style: Measured and informative. Slow, steady delivery. Speaking as someone accustomed to briefing. Slight pause before the second clause. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。御社との連携、延びた期間、活用したいです。
lines.en: Yes. We'd like to make full use of the extended partnership with your organization.
lines.style: Respectful and earnest. Clear articulation on key words. Leaning forward slightly in posture. Warm but formal. No rush—each phrase gets its due weight.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 難題に挑んだ姿勢、若手警官、頼もしいです。
lines.en: Your team's willingness to tackle difficult challenges—the younger officers especially—that's reassuring.
lines.style: Genuine approval underneath the formality. Slight warm note on 'reassuring.' Not condescending. The tone of someone noticing real competence and saying so plainly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。情報共有のショートカット、整えます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll establish better channels for information sharing.
lines.style: Confident and direct. Crisp attack on the opening word. Businesslike but not robotic. The tone of someone who knows what needs doing and will do it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 社会が変われば、警察も変わります。
lines.en: As society changes, policing has to change with it.
lines.style: Thoughtful and measured. A slight pause before the second clause. Quietly philosophical without being heavy. Speaking from observation rather than ideology.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域とつなげる活動、引き続き協力します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll keep supporting these community-building activities going forward.
lines.style: Steady commitment in the voice. Slight nod forward on 'keep supporting.' Warm undertone. The assurance of someone who means what he says and will follow through.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 記念に、折り紙の警察キャラ、配ったこと、あります。
lines.en: I actually handed out origami police characters once, as a memento.
lines.style: A hint of gentle humor in the memory. Softer attack than before. Almost private—like sharing something that still makes him smile. Slight warmth on 'origami.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。出張時、乗り継ぎ、警察情報も共有します。
lines.en: Of course. When we travel between offices, we'll make sure to share that information with your department as well.
lines.style: Easy and accommodating. Natural conversational rhythm. Warmth in the 'of course.' Not formal anymore—the tone shifts to someone who's found common ground and is willing to go further.
